items.title: Reggie Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 22, 2018
items.q: we have a mutual friend, Chris Hemingway, who I was on the road with with Postmodern Jukebox.

ctx.x: Yeah. That’s a good niche these days, it seems to be a good niche.

That’s their niche and people really respond to it. I saw Branford and I was talking to him and we have a mutual friend, Chris Hemingway, who I was on the road with with Postmodern Jukebox. And I said, “Hey I just got off the road with Chris Hemingway.” He goes, “Oh Postmodern Jukebox, I love that band.” I didn’t expect for him to say that you know.
Okay. Let’s wrap up with what do you think of the state of jazz education? Do you have an opinion?
